## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle text is the Yuán-period commentary by [圓覺](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E8%A6%BA) Yuánjué on [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's *[Yuán rén lùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0105)* (T1886) — distinct from and post-dating [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's earlier Northern-Sòng *[Fā wēi lù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0106)* (X1031). Yuánjué's commentary takes a more systematic approach than Jìngyuán's, providing line-by-line philological-doctrinal exposition for Yuán readers.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1300 – 1368) reflects the Yuán dynasty period during which the work was composed. Yuánjué's commentary continued the Sòng-Yuán Buddhist tradition of intensive commentarial scholarship on Zōngmì's foundational doxographical text.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1032) collection.
